title: Better Two Than One

questions.question: Who did the Preacher praise as happier than the living?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:2 (ESV): "And I thought the dead who are already dead more fortunate than the living who are still alive." (Note: asking "happier" or "more fortunate").

questions.question: Who is better off than both the dead and the living?
options: He who has not yet been
questions.correctAnswer: He who has not yet been
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:3 (ESV): "But better than both is he who has not yet been and has not seen the evil deeds that are done under the sun."

questions.question: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:9 (ESV): "Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their toil."

questions.question: A threefold cord is not quickly what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:12 (ESV): "a threefold cord is not quickly broken."

questions.question: Better was a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:13 (ESV): "Better was a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who no longer knew how to take advice."

questions.question: What springs from envy of one's neighbor?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:4 (ESV): "Then I saw that all toil and all skill in work come from a man's envy of his neighbor."

questions.question: The fool folds his hands and eats his own what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:5 (ESV): "The fool folds his hands and eats his own flesh."

questions.question: Better is a handful of quietness than two hands full of toil and what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:6 (ESV): "than two hands full of toil and a striving after wind."

questions.question: If two lie together, they keep warm, but how can one keep warm how?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:11 (ESV): "but how can one keep warm alone?"

questions.question: For if they fall, one will lift up his what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:10 (ESV): "For if they fall, one will lift up his fellow."

questions.question: I saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun. And behold, the tears of the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:1 (ESV): "And behold, the tears of the oppressed, and they had no one to comfort them!"

questions.question: On the side of their oppressors there was what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:1 (ESV): "On the side of their oppressors there was power,"

questions.question: There was no end of all the people, all of whom he led. Yet those who come later will not do what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:16 (ESV): "Yet those who come later will not rejoice in him."

questions.question: One is alone, and he has no second, either son or what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:8 (ESV): "one person who has no other, either son or brother,"

questions.question: He asks, "For whom am I toiling and depriving myself of..." what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:8 (ESV): "For whom am I toiling and depriving myself of pleasure?"

key_verse_text: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their toil. For if they fall, one will lift up his fellow.
